title: Uncomment retry logic in useChatStreaming.ts
action: Uncomment the StreamErrorPayload interface, isStreamErrorPayload type guard, retries counter, and retry block in useChatStreaming.ts to restore retry functionality

criteria: npx vitest run src/hooks/useChatStreaming.test.tsx — all 10 tests pass

implementation: Uncomment lines 29-43 (StreamErrorPayload interface + isStreamErrorPayload type guard), lines 74-75 (retries variable initialization in for loop), and lines 174-183 (retry if-block with continue). Ensure the for(;;) loop uses retries correctly: let retries = 0 in the loop init, retries++ in the retry block, condition checks retries < maxRetries.
